span.p:
ONE IDENTICAL FIXTURE RESPONSE
a plausible but low-confidence claim
containing a person's detail
plus one pii.email span (ADR-015)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ONE MULTI-LABEL SIGNAL (FR-DET-005)
labels: hallucination.ungrounded_claim + privacy.person
planes: performance + responsibility
+ a pii.email signal from tier1_pii

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THE SAME POLICY ENGINE
same code, same build, same algorithm
zero use-case conditionals (FR-POL-002)

div.style: color: rgb(55, 65, 81) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
pii.* → edit
hallucination.ungrounded_claim → edit
privacy.person → pass

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
EDIT
softened claim
+ redacted detail
user sees a safe answer

div.style: color: rgb(55, 65, 81) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
pii.* → block
hallucination.* → pass
privacy.person → block

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
BLOCK
fallback message
internal PII policy

div.style: color: rgb(55, 65, 81) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
pii.* → escalate
hallucination.* → escalate
privacy.person → escalate

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ESCALATE
quarantined, review item
non-streaming: nothing ever
reached the user (ADR-014)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THREE AUDIT RECORDS, SIDE BY SIDE
same signals · three verdicts · three policy_version stamps

div.style: color: rgb(75, 85, 99) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.i:
Not one line of code differs between these pipelines.
This is why it is a control plane, not a filter.
